name: Size / Dual Sign Rank
details: A linearly independent column set has size at most the number of rows.
proof: Every realizing matrix for the incidence sign matrix has \(|\mathcal H|\) rows. A set of linearly independent columns in such a matrix has size at most its rank, hence at most \(|\mathcal H|\). This applies to the fixed column set in the definition of dual sign rank.
witness_verification: For the family #classes/full_cube with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $2^n$ and $n$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
